extraction_text: The gods built a powerful chariot designed by Vishvakarma for Shiva.

The chariot was constructed using cosmic and natural elements: the Earth Goddess with cities, mountains, forests, and islands formed the chariot body; Mount Mandara as the axle; rivers as the rear; the four directions as covering; planets as the base; stars as railings.
Dharma, Artha, and Kama formed the yoke-pole; vegetation with flowers, fruits, and sprouts became the ropes; the Sun and Moon became the two wheels; Day and Night became the auspicious wings.

The ten Nagas led by Dhritarashtra became another yoke-pole; the sky became the yoke; clouds became yoke-straps; virtues like steadfastness and wisdom became yoke-pins; the starry sky became the spotted leather covering.
Indra, Varuna, Yama, and Kubera became the chariot horses; the two crescent and two full moon goddesses became reins, charioteer, and horse ornaments.
